description: V0.10b live shared-prefix decision experiment: at 8 recorded branch points, the recorded conversation and initial proposal, then a neutral continuation (control) or the engine's exact preview (treatment), 20 draws per arm, one request at a time. Declared before any request (PLAN.md).
design: option A of docs/audits/v0.10b-branch-point-inventory.md, approved by the owner: Gemma 1 accepted-preview and 3 refused-preview points (all its distinct contexts), Qwen 2 and 2

control.text:
CONTINUE. Nothing has been submitted yet.

Now reply with your final decision, one JSON object {"reason": ..., "actions": [...]}. It replaces your reply above: give the same actions to keep it, changed actions to revise it, or "actions": [] to submit nothing. It is then validated and submitted as before.
control.rule: the neutral continuation: its second paragraph is the treatment message's last paragraph, byte for byte

treatment.opsNote: The operations actions in your reply have no preview (the simulator previews staffing actions only).
treatment.rule: llm-agent 4's review message, unchanged: the engine's preview of the proposal's staffing actions at the recorded state, as compact JSON

arms.assignment: both arms at every point, every round: the arm is assigned by the schedule, not by the model or the state

order: per model in modelOrder; draws 1..20 as rounds; in each round every point and arm of the model once, in the order of SHA-256('dreamteam-v10b-order/1|<round>|<point id>|<arm>'); one request at a time
preflight: GET /health, /v1/models and /openapi.json only (public, no inference); no inference preflight

request.body: the recorded proposal request (model, messages, temperature 0, max_tokens 4096, response_format json_object) with its messages followed by the recorded proposal (assistant) and the arm's message (user); serialized as the agent serialized it (json.dumps, keys in the recorded order); nothing added (no seed)

server.observed: before the run, before each round and after the run: /health, the server version, the OpenAPI document's SHA-256 and the experiment models' entries in /v1/models; the cached prompt tokens each response reports
server.material: the server version, the OpenAPI SHA-256, or either experiment model's entry changes; or /health is not healthy
unavailable: cache clearing, cache disabling, cold starts and server settings: admin-only, not authorized, not used

stop.health: a /health answer other than healthy before a round stops the run
stop.serverChange: a material change before a round stops the run

failures: every request is recorded, failed or not; no retry, no replacement, no rerun; a failed request or an invalid reply is the draw's outcome (invalid); a stopped run is analysed as far as it went, the rest of its draws reported as not run
resources: the client on the Pi under systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=1G nice -n 10; one request in flight

outcomes.primary: per point and arm, the distribution of the final decision over the 20 draws: kept, revised or abandoned (A4.response_of against the recorded proposal: the same actions in any order, other actions, or none) and invalid (a failed request, or a reply llm-agent 3's strict parser rejects, details not allowed), all in the denominator
secondary: raw, canonical JSON and action agreement within an arm
direction and parameter changes of revised decisions (actions matched by type and employee, role or op; fields that differ)
the final decision accepted, refused or no action (the engine's validate of llm-agent 3's batches at the recorded state)

financial evidence v1 (unchanged) of each distinct final decision at the recorded state: affordability per batch and the commitment of applied batches, credit support, reversibility and direct operational exposure of executed actions; the commitment change against the proposal
latency, tokens, cached tokens and finish reasons (live metadata, apart)
outcomes.notComputed: no composite score; no outcome is called better because it changed

statistics.perPoint: counts and proportions with Wilson 95% score intervals per arm; treatment minus control per outcome with Newcombe hybrid score 95% intervals; the round-blocked table of control and treatment outcomes (the schedule puts both arms of a point in every round)
statistics.pooled: after the per-point results: the per-point differences, their unweighted mean and the number of points with a positive or negative difference, per model and overall; no interval over 4 or 8 clustered points
statistics.claims: descriptive; no population claim about models, prompts or practices; no hypothesis test

continuation.rule: each distinct final decision at the recorded state: its batches validated (staffing previewed first); if every batch is valid, each applied in order, the engine's observation after each; then every later day advanced with no action; a refused decision is not submitted (no retry here), so nothing is applied
continuation.recorded: apply results, validate/apply agreement, digests after the decision and at each later day, the observed state at the end
continuation.purpose: a reproducibility and mechanics check, not an outcome

replay: the analysis reads the recorded responses and the engine only; every request's SHA-256 is rebuilt from the points; CI regenerates the points' check, the schedule and the analysis and compares them byte for byte on every platform
